slides.alt: A baked plum cake in a round tin, held on a wooden counter. Text: Autumn is when the cooking ideas come.
Top view of the plum cake with whole plums baked into the golden surface. Text: Suddenly, plums, grapes and pumpkins are everywhere.
Plum cake with a slice cut out, showing the soft inside, on a kitchen counter. Text: As the days get shorter, I spend more time indoors.
Two white plates with slices of plum cake and cake forks on a dark wooden table. Text: It soothes me to make something that smells this good.
A slice of plum cake dusted with powdered sugar on a white plate, with a bowl of lemons and apples behind. Text: And then I share it.
